summary: Israeli airstrikes hit al-Sha'ra in eastern Beqaa Valley while Lebanese alert system logs 115 warnings on Nov 19 including 57 drone detections across Nabatieh district. IRGC commander Ahmad Vahidi warns US/Israeli actions may compel Iran to revise defense doctrine on missile range and geographic strike limits. Iraqi federal forces surround Jurf al-Sakhar with 20:00 withdrawal deadline; IRGC-backed Kataib Hezbollah refuses to leave, risking confrontation.
key_points: Lebanese media reports Israeli airstrikes in eastern Beqaa Valley targeting al-Sha'ra area. (Source: @manniefabian/59559)

Detailed Israeli attack log for Nov 19 lists airstrikes on Qantara (2), Talousa, Zoutar al-Sharqiyah, Kfar Shuba, al-Sha'ra, plus artillery on 15+ villages and machine-gun sweeping. (Source: @redlinkleb/54024)
IRGC commander Ahmad Vahidi states US and Israeli actions may prompt Iran to change its defense doctrine, including missile range and geographic strike limitations. (Source: @N12chat/236095)
Iraqi federal forces have entered Jurf al-Sakhar, surrounding the area; IRGC-backed Kataib Hezbollah vows not to leave despite government deadline of 20:00. (Source: @shin_persian/12627)

Israel upgrades David's Sling air defense system range to intercept missiles and drones, aiming to reduce reliance on expensive interceptors. (Source: @yediotnews25/138244)
